title: Echo Voids Sky Only
description: This is a modified version of Echo Voids by ShaiTheLamb, focused on improving the End sky. Published with permission from the original author
body:
Echo Voids Sky Only

Echo Voids Sky Only is a modified version of the original Echo Voids mod by ShaiTheLamb that focuses on improving the End sky.

This version enhances the visual appearance of the End dimension with a custom sky while keeping the core experience intact.

 Credits:

This mod is a modified version of the original Echo Voids mod by ShaiTheLamb.

Published with permission from the original author.
